metadata.title: Multilingual Human Evaluation of Educational NLP Responses
metadata.scientific_disclaimer: Multilingual human evaluation framework. Separately evaluates English (en), Telugu (te), Romanized Telugu (te-Latn), and Telugu-English code-mixed (te-en) responses without collapsing language categories. If no real multilingual participant data is provided, status remains strictly HUMAN_DATA_REQUIRED. Zero human evaluations or language fluency ratings are fabricated.
metadata.ethical_notice: Requires institutional ethical approval / IRB clearance and informed consent prior to human data collection.

modalities.name: Standard Academic English

modalities.name: Academic Telugu (Native Script)
modalities.description: Explanations presented in Telugu script incorporating standardized Telugu technical terminology.

modalities.name: Romanized Telugu (Transliterated)
modalities.description: Telugu language phonetically written in Latin script; subject to spelling and transliteration variance.

modalities.name: Telugu-English Code-Mixed
modalities.description: Conversational academic engineering register featuring technical English nouns embedded in Telugu syntactic frames.
